info.title: API.SH: 2dehands
info.description: The 2dehands API from API.SH: public 2dehands data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The search suggestions 2dehands shows for a partial term, each with the category it points to and that category's parent.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/2dehands-autocomplete

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only suggestions within this category id (0 = all, default).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The 2dehands category tree with the number of ads in each (within a search when `q` is given): the top-level categories and every sub-category with its id, parent and link. Pass an id as `category_id` for one branch; use ids with /2dehands/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/2dehands-categories

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Count within ads matching this search.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One 2dehands ad: price and price type, full description, every attribute, delivery and shipping, photos, location, posting date, views, favourites, bids and, for business sellers, the seller (name, type, years active, profile and all-ads links). Pass `url`, or `latest=1` with search params. Private sellers' names, phone numbers and email addresses are never returned (masked in ad text).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/2dehands-listing

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `1`: open the first current result of a search made with this route's search params (q, location and filters) instead of an id. Ads expire, so this keeps a link working.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
2dehands (2dehands.be) classified ads for a keyword with category, postcode and distance, price, attribute filters (condition, delivery, brand...), offered-since and sort. Each result has price, attributes, photos, location and distance, date, traits and, for business sellers, the seller. `facets` lists attribute values with ids for `attribute_ids`, `categories` the category ids. Private sellers' names, phone numbers and email addresses are never returned (masked in ad text).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/2dehands-search

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Top-level category id (445 Fietsen en Brommers, 91 Auto's, 31 Audio Tv en Foto); see `categories`.

parameters.name: distance_km
parameters.description: Radius in km around the postcode.

parameters.name: attribute_ids
parameters.description: Attribute value ids from `facets`, comma-separated (e.g. 30 = new, 31 = as good as new, 32 = used).

parameters.name: title_and_description
parameters.description: false: match keywords in titles only.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results page, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A 2dehands business seller's profile (name, profile link, website, verified flag, address where shown) and their active ads, 30 a page: title, price and price type, description, photos, category, attributes, location and posting date. Sellers are looked up by id or profile link; private sellers are not available. 2dehands lists the first 5,000 ads of a seller.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/2dehands-seller

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: 2dehands seller id (the number in the seller's profile link), or pass `url`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
